'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Nelson LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Aaron Nelson''' / '''Airdog2003''' / deck '''SoCal Commando'''. Opens Slave Quarters + Yoda's Hut; inventory start Profit.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' Airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
